mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transfer_order (order_no, source_warehouse_id, target_warehouse_id, status, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{sourceWarehouseId}, #{targetWarehouseId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO transfer_order_item (order_id, sku_id, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM transfer_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, order_id, sku_id, quantity FROM transfer_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, order_id, sku_id, quantity FROM transfer_order_item WHERE order_id IN #{orderId} ORDER BY order_id, id
mapper.update: UPDATE transfer_order SET status = 'RESERVED', reserved_by = #{userId}, reserved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREATED'
UPDATE transfer_order SET status = 'CREATED', released_by = #{userId}, released_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RESERVED'
UPDATE transfer_order SET status = 'IN_TRANSIT', dispatched_by = #{userId}, dispatched_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RESERVED'
UPDATE transfer_order SET status = 'COMPLETED', received_by = #{userId}, received_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'IN_TRANSIT'
UPDATE transfer_order SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_by = #{userId}, cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREATED'
